(3) Close-up returns to the woman's hands as she places the tile into her hand and discards another. The wood grain of the table is clearly visible, and the purple tiles are neatly aligned. The lighting is uniform and professional, highlighting the textures of the tile. (4) A wide shot shows a man in a blue striped shirt excitedly reaching for a tile across the table. The table is cluttered with Mahjong sets. Large red text 'Self-draw' appears as a variety graphic over the center of the frame. (5) The scene transitions to a medium shot of a man in a blue button-down shirt who is wide-eyed and laughing with intense joy. A woman in a yellow dress stands behind him, clapping enthusiastically. Animated gold coins fall across the frame.
